components.label: Spire Legacy for Slay the Spire 2 with BaseLib

notes.beforeInstall: Requires Slay the Spire 2 regular v0.107.1 or compatible public-beta. Includes BaseLib 3.4.7 and original mod artwork. This Melty launcher mapping targets Windows; the Workshop package also supports native Linux and Steam Deck.
notes.firstLaunch: Accept the game's mod notice and enable BaseLib and Spire Legacy. Choose The Heir; Family Manor & Heir Lab appears under the character information; press Y to open it. The first family run jumps into a fight. All later runs use normal maps and events.
